with the CSRF token bound to its session (synchronizer token).

Locations the caller may see right now. Every row is re-authorised on each
request: the share must be active and unexpired, the two users must still
be friends and neither may have blocked the other.

get.description:
Response filtering happens here on the server, not in the client:
self -> full profile, accepted friend -> profile, anyone else -> empty.
A block (either direction) is indistinguishable from "not a friend".
